purpose: Separately record the controlling public-records access law for each 2026 geography pilot; identify eligible requester, public-data presumptions, exemptions and primary official citations before any conclusion of noncompliance.
geography_evidence_boundary: Census place/county edges do not show governmental wrongdoing, establish agency jurisdiction for a disputed record, or automatically create record-access rights.

jurisdictions.name: Minnesota
jurisdictions.access_rule: Government data presumptively public unless classified otherwise by applicable state/federal law
jurisdictions.requester_rule: Public-data access protections; verify exceptions and request procedures
jurisdictions.scope_caveat: Subject-specific nonpublic classifications and separate government-entity exclusions need review

jurisdictions.name: Wisconsin
jurisdictions.access_rule: Strong public-access presumption; applicable statutory, common-law, and public-interest exceptions
jurisdictions.requester_rule: Record requesters generally do not need to state a purpose; confirm precise rule for requested record
jurisdictions.scope_caveat: Do not treat Census geography as proof the municipality has the requested record

jurisdictions.name: Iowa
jurisdictions.access_rule: Public examination of government records, subject to confidentiality exceptions
jurisdictions.scope_caveat: Chapter 22.7 and other statutes exclude confidential material

jurisdictions.name: Illinois
jurisdictions.statute: 5 ILCS 140, Illinois Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.access_rule: Public-body records accessible subject to statutory exemptions
jurisdictions.requester_rule: Written request to public-body FOIA officer where applicable
jurisdictions.scope_caveat: Act-specific scope, timelines and exemptions must be applied

jurisdictions.name: Alabama
jurisdictions.access_rule: Residents generally may inspect and copy public records subject to exceptions
jurisdictions.requester_rule: Resident eligibility and agency procedure must be checked
jurisdictions.scope_caveat: Certain sensitive/security records and judicial-branch procedure exceptions apply; no universal FOIA claim

checks: Identify agency holding requested record and responsible records custodian
Determine whether the record is public, confidential, exempt or mixed
Preserve current statutory URL and version with observation date; record access rights independently of Census maps
Request precise record, scope, date range and format; do not assume records exist
Record agency response, refusal basis, redactions and appeal route using applicable state's statutes
No public-records rights violations are inferred from Census geographic changes
No active government enforcement authority, adjudicated claim, or election outcome asserted
